### Quiz pool

Create at least five questions. Keep prompts under 256 characters, choices under 32 characters, and answers under 45 characters.

### Relationship checklist

- [ ] Every note is assigned to this unit and no other unit.
- [ ] Notes are in the correct order inside the unit.
- [ ] Every quiz is assigned to this unit and no other unit.
- [ ] Relevant source IDs reference existing records in the shared course library.
- [ ] No source has been duplicated just for this unit.
- [ ] No question requires content from a later unit.
- [ ] The unit has at least five standalone questions for practice and Daily Train.

### Review

- [ ] The note has one outcome and no filler.
- [ ] Each card contains one idea.
- [ ] Claims are accurate and traceable.
- [ ] Quiz answers are unambiguous.
- [ ] The unit works on desktop and mobile.
